statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-26519: musl 0.9.13 through 1.2.5 can write out of bounds when iconv() converts untrusted EUC-KR input to UTF-8 (https://www.openwall.com/lists/musl/2025/02/13/1). It was fixed upstream by https://git.musl-libc.org/cgit/musl/commit/?id=e5adcd97b5196e29991b524237381a0202a60659 ('iconv: fix erroneous input validation in EUC-KR decoder') and https://git.musl-libc.org/cgit/musl/commit/?id=c47ad25ea3b484e10326f933e927c0bc8cded3da ('iconv: harden UTF-8 output code path against input decoder bugs'). Both are in musl 1.2.6. This owner builds musl 1.2.5 from Alpine's aports, whose musl package applies both commits as CVE-2025-26519.patch and lists the CVE as fixed in 1.2.5-r10. The DHI Alpine 3.23 repository publishes 1.2.5-r10, r21, r22, r23 and r24 on x86_64 and aarch64. The lowest, 1.2.5-r10, records in its package metadata that it was built from aports commit https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/commit/1a5f5e699b2eae883e73c93a789f87bd89a2a190, whose musl APKBUILD (pkgrel 10) applies that patch. The aports musl APKBUILD at pkgrel 24 still applies it. Alpine's tracker lists 3.23's 1.2.5-r21 through r24 as fixed (https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2025-26519). Every published build carries the fix, so the range closes at 1.2.5-r10.
